required.note: Adjacent sibling feature sections ('Display your company's name…' and 'Branded Call performance analytics') swapped in document order. Spec M5 DoD: a single component_swapped, not missing+added.

forbidden.note: An adjacent pairwise swap must be classified as one swap, not a generic reorder (spec §8 / M5).

notes: Two complete <section> siblings exchanged in-place; file length unchanged, content byte-identical within each section. The identity-first matcher must pair both sections (position can lower a tiebreak score but never veto identity — spec §8) so the sequence differ sees a swap. Accepted knock-ons per manifest: visual_region_changed / page-area movement across the two sections' vertical span.
